subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should OpenClaw accept custom `bailian` Qwen compat inference as a built-in provider default before the broader Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan support is resolved?
rationale: The source gap is real, but changing provider/model reasoning defaults for existing custom configs is compatibility-sensitive and the broader canonical issue still needs model and endpoint proof.

options.title: Require Cleanup And Matching Proof
options.body: Remove the vLLM policy change, keep the generic configured-model inference slice, and require redacted live output for a `bailian` Qwen row without explicit `reasoning`.

options.title: Accept Narrow Default Change
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the custom-provider default change after proof, while leaving the bundled Coding Plan catalog work tracked separately.

options.title: Defer To Broader Coding Plan Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want all Ali Bailian reasoning behavior handled through the Qwen provider/catalog issue instead of a custom-provider inference special case.

recommendation.title: Require Cleanup And Matching Proof
recommendation.body: Remove the vLLM policy change, keep the generic configured-model inference slice, and require redacted live output for a `bailian` Qwen row without explicit `reasoning`.
